dct_description_sm: The objective of this project was to conduct multi-stakeholder conferences on the subject of water security policy and sustainable development as it relates to climate change and Aboriginal and Northern communities. In doing so, government, industry, NGO, academia, and First Nation community members were engaged in building the capacity of First Nations communities.

dct_title_s: First Nations and Water Security: Implications of Climate Change for Community Sustainability
